avis.titre: Hello Again, Friends! I'm Back with an Update! :)
avis.texte: I wrote a review here about 8 months ago, it actually turned out to be "the most helpful" review for this PEACH & LILY Power Cocktail. I'm excited about that, but I'm back to update you all on my well-over 6 months consistent use of this product. First off, we talked about how AHA's work on your skin's surface, which means you will see quicker/ more immediate results than when you use BHA's (oil-soluble, like salicylic acid, which tend to be milder than AHA's due to the larger molecules). Now, glycolic acid is the strongest AHA you can get your hands on (tiny molecules, makes it more irritating on your skin, stronger exfoliation). Next up is lactic acid, not as strong or abrasive as glycolic acid but still gets the job done NICELY! How it works? Lactic acid promotes cellular turnover - when your dead skin cells are replaced with new skin cells… with the beautiful process of exfoliation. This specific PEACH & LILY serum has never been too harsh on MY skin (that's just me, sensitive Sally over here). The very first few times upon application, my skin felt a bit spicy and reddened after, but the feeling and redness did not last long at all, especially if you use it before bed and wake up to stunning skin. Nowadays, over 6 months later, when I apply this serum, I am met with hydrated, glowy (but not greasy), plump + firm, even-textured skin.
